verdicts.reason: A: four rows are jammed into the short banner, the SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline (reversed reading order), the flavour pills are in reverse order, the left third is just the decorative circles, and the oversized CTA nearly touches the right edge. B has the same reversed brand order, reversed pills and edge-hugging CTA, and is worse: the subcopy is squeezed into a tiny two-line fragment beside the pills that is barely readable and breaks the grid.
